_comment: Copy this file to extra_reminders.json and edit it. Each key is a role name
(matched loosely, so "Fortune Teller" = "fortuneteller") and each value is
a list of reminder labels added on top of whatever the role already has.
A label the role already has is not duplicated. Works for official and
custom roles alike. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
The GUI's Checklist tab has an "Add reminder..." button that edits this
